passes.reason: All four provider combinations and re-enable were rechecked on current source in 48 captures. Deselected providers have zero visible dependent text; switches stay visible and source tests preserve private config bytes and BTC selection.

Fresh 80x24 captures and the long-preview regression show reachable controls, sticky feed switches/Return and a scroll path. The current-format consequence summary is first in the bounded result view.
Failure notice is visible above the body, names Refresh recovery, and clears on a successful read. Synthetic backend-error capture contains no exception/private payload.

Frequent task is one pointer click per feed. Keyboard path is focus plus Space; re-enable is Space again. No repeated config entry or confirmation. Operator counts are expert models; no task-time claim.
Saved feed preferences survive panel reentry. BTC asset selection survives off/on within the same panel. Closing and reopening the foreground screen does not stop shared services.
Show feeds accurately maps each checkbox to all content for that provider; Return navigates to the existing Oracle screen; Preview fixture reports unsigned state and never invokes execute.
Title and sticky Return identify the panel and its parent. Feed preferences survive reentry; Escape and screen lifecycle are covered by the current integrated suite.

The actual Console.preview current-market message was generated with fake adapters in a temporary home and rendered at all three sizes. MARKET, indicative entry and close-unavailable information is first; the complete backend message remains scrollable. No signing or execution occurred.
Owner-facing labels use feed, Asset, Refresh, Preview and Return. Statistical terms retain units, contextual-score qualification and paper/no-fill limits; no unsupported likelihood claim.

Feed switches remove whole provider sections instead of leaving disabled shells; both-hidden gives a specific re-enable path. Preview remains a separate staged action; no toggle submits or changes arming.

All 48 current render cells were visually inspected through 12 contact sheets and their geometry/text records. Provider selection is the stable first group. Long results no longer dominate the monitor workspace; existing semantic action colors remain.

The sought provider is front-labelled in its persistent checkbox and in the price row. Feed rows, paper status and separate action/result group remain distinguishable at 80/120/180 columns; source-specific blocks disappear completely when hidden.

Feed selectors form one horizontal group; source-specific sections hide together. The bordered comparison groups synchronized quotes and basis; manual execution has a separate grouped container and result region.
Current captured hit boxes have no horizontal control overflow. The two-column workspace remains; manual-preview controls fit their body viewport. Short-height content uses its explicit scroll path.

Dense and empty captures retain separate borders/headings; hiding all sources collapses workspace and trading controls and presents one recovery instruction. Long source observations wrap within the scroll region.

Full fake public wallet identity and venue labels fit/wrap; current prices retain USD, bps, signed movement and age units. The long result has an independent scroll region instead of expanding into the footer.

Warning Arm, primary Preview, destructive Submit and disabled actions keep distinct roles and text labels. Provider freshness now says LIVE/DELAYED/STALE in addition to colored dots; rising/falling bars retain arrows and explicit movement text.

Repaired measured bright-bar label failure by choosing black/white from actual luminance; 201 intensities satisfy 4.5:1. Preview now uses opaque white on darker blue. Default rendered colors are available; actual user terminal font/palette and every system-theme pair remain unavailable, so no full WCAG conformance claim.
passes.next_action: Obtain the missing native evidence with an authorized inspector; retain NEEDS_EVIDENCE until then.

passes.reason: Checked default comparison enclosure, checkbox mark and focus boundary against the dark surface. The macOS terminal accessibility/color pipeline and full selected-state compositing measurements are unavailable; retain this as partial rather than infer all contrast from screenshots.
passes.next_action: Obtain the missing native evidence with an authorized inspector; retain NEEDS_EVIDENCE until then.

passes.reason: Freshness has LIVE/DELAYED/STALE text and ages; retained basis says STALE PAIR. Bars have arrows and signed percentages; feed controls use checked X and labels. Original dot-only status was repaired while implementing the controls.
No necessary action is icon-only. Arrow glyphs accompany signed movement; provider switches include names and checked state; Return, Refresh and Preview are literal labeled controls.
The scoped terminal panel renders text, tables, selectors and colored bar buttons. It contains no image/media assets, cropping or image alternatives to inspect.

Actual Checkbox click and Space alter only the intended provider view. Buttons retain Textual focus/pressed styles, and deselection collapses matching sections rather than disabling unrelated controls.

Recorded hit rectangles show provider targets 16x3 and 17x3 terminal cells, with separate controls and successful real pointer activation at all three terminal sizes. CSS-pixel WCAG target-size minima are not asserted for a terminal cell renderer.

Actual Tab, Space and Shift+Tab sequence disables both feeds and restores Coinbase without pointer input, preserving focus on the feed controls. Escape/Return and manual-preview keyboard regressions remain supported.

Provider toggles retain visible focus across hide/restore. Short-terminal Preview focus scrolls into view while sticky switches remain visible. Existing modal stack/open/close teardown tests passed; no focus trap was observed in the scoped paths.

Finite positive collateral validation prevents malformed previews and gives a corrective message while keeping selection/input. Existing rejected/malformed action and single-flight tests passed. Only synthetic unsigned preview is exercised; funded Submit is outside this task.

Rechecked all 16 frozen states at all three sizes on the final revision. Null nested per-asset/model sections stay recoverable, repeated switches preserve state, and current-format long previews keep the monitor/controls usable.

Textual DOM/widget labels and values are inspectable, but this harness has no native terminal accessibility-tree bridge. A DOM dump cannot stand in for the native accessibility exposure required by this selected method.
passes.next_action: Obtain the missing native evidence with an authorized inspector; retain NEEDS_EVIDENCE until then.

passes.reason: Terminal-column reflow at 80/120/180 columns and short-height scrolling were exercised and the disappearing-control defect was repaired. Native terminal font scaling/line spacing and its OS accessibility interaction are not available to this fixture renderer; no WCAG resize claim is made.
passes.next_action: Obtain the missing native evidence with an authorized inspector; retain NEEDS_EVIDENCE until then.

passes.reason: All 48 final cells were rerendered. Independent row/region geometry checks confirm persistent switches, zero provider leaks and a bounded six-row result area; every manual-preview action fits within its current body viewport.

Repository documents an English-only terminal panel with fixed BTC/ZEC choices and explicit USD/bps units. There is no locale switch, translated resource bundle or supported RTL mode in this scoped interface. This absence does not certify arbitrary terminal font shaping.

The panel has no autoplay or intentional flashing; price updates retain focus and feed switches reduce visible data. Textual focus scrolling animates. Native reduced-motion preferences and terminal sensory behavior were not available, so this selected evidence remains partial.
passes.next_action: Obtain the missing native evidence with an authorized inspector; retain NEEDS_EVIDENCE until then.

passes.reason: Timestamped controlled-delay trace records visible in-progress acknowledgement, disabled repeated action, one preview request, completion and joined owned workers. This is a synthetic lab trace, not user task-time or field performance evidence.

Existing real loopback WebSocket handshake/reconnect/owner-stop tests and new foreground pause/resume tests pass. Snapshot faults retain controls and expose Refresh recovery; restored reads clear the failure. No shared collector is stopped or restarted.

Safe fixtures verify reversible feed hide/restore, cancellation before dispatch, single-flight operations and explicit preview-before-submit. Feed controls never mutate armed configuration. No real destructive/trading action was attempted; executed transactions are not represented as undoable.

Both independent feed choices have symmetric off/on controls and unchanged both-on defaults. Hidden feeds do not alter the separately armed execution state, and both-hidden explicitly says shared paper recording continues. No purchase, forced activation or asymmetric refusal path is introduced.

The panel reuses existing Textual Checkbox, Button, Select and table conventions and its established midnight/cyan palette. Existing bold action labels, source literal escaping, two-column workbench and semantic action variants are retained; Preview darkening repairs contrast within the same palette.

Actual Textual APIs and run_test execute on this macOS Python environment, with keyboard/pointer fixtures and three terminal sizes. Native Terminal event delivery and the newly installed revision are separate pending acceptance evidence. Context7 was quota-blocked; no new library API assumptions were substituted as documentation results.
passes.next_action: Obtain the missing native evidence with an authorized inspector; retain NEEDS_EVIDENCE until then.

passes.reason: Current-source preview makes MARKET/indicative-entry/current-close-unavailable explicit before detailed amounts. Freshness and STALE PAIR are textual. Paper/model/no-fill qualifications remain. This does not establish funded execution or future profitability.

No runnable VoiceOver/screen-reader automation or spoken-output capture is available in this harness. The selected assistive-technology task cannot be replaced by expert inference, terminal screenshots or widget names.

passes.reason: Known fixtures preserve price USD, signed basis bps, source timestamps, signed bar movement, sample counts and context-score qualifiers. Basis requires both fresh synchronized sources and disappears for either hidden feed. Missing model components show unsupported/unknown rather than invented statistics.
The scoped panel has no search box, search index or query/results workflow. Asset and bar selectors are fixed view filters covered by selection/transition tests.

Essential provider state and source ages are visible text, and bar details have ordinary buttons with keyboard activation. Hover tooltips add explanations rather than being the only necessary information. No drag/multipoint/path-only action is required.

The panel displays frozen statistical model/observer outputs but has no interactive AI/agent control, generative completion, model stop/retry or streamed generated response. No inference job is started by this UI task.

Fresh temporary homes start both feeds on without a setup write to execution configuration. First useful action is the labeled checkbox. Reopening a saved both-hidden view keeps explicit re-enable guidance and both selectors; failed snapshot guidance names Refresh.

Safe known-armed, disarmed, unknown/read-error and wallet mismatch fixtures retain their permission presentation and execution gates. Feed preferences are separate from config.json; toggling them leaves its armed bytes unchanged. No login, credentials, signing or funded request was exercised.

In-panel loading/failure/operation notices remain visible or persist until recovery; they do not steal checkbox focus or create duplicate actions. Hiding providers removes their status noise, and existing user sound preferences are not changed by feed-view controls.

findings.evidence: Task goal requires independent feed controls. Existing compose provides Asset, Bar, Refresh, Return, Arm, Preview, Submit and Close; it exposes no feed visibility action. New provider-visibility regression fails at missing Checkbox locator.
findings.impact: The user cannot reduce provider noise or hide Coinbase-derived rows, prices and book indicators.
findings.fix: Add persistent independent view toggles; hide all provider-dependent surfaces; pause only the foreground Coinbase subscription.
findings.verification_plan: Real Textual checkbox clicks, all disabled/reenabled states and asset switches; separate settings config preservation and socket lifecycle checks.
findings.reason: Confirmed task/workflow/standards consequence under the UI severity ladder; repaired and rechecked on current source.

findings.locator: live-both-small: leverage-workspace y=23 height=1; leverage-preview y=33 below 24-row terminal
findings.evidence: sweep1/live-both-small.svg and .json show the prices and manual controls outside the visible viewport, with no parent scrolling path.
findings.impact: The owner cannot inspect the live provider comparison or reach manual preview using the pointer in an 80x24 terminal.
findings.fix: Keep feed toggles and Return visible. Put the remaining page in a scrollable body on short terminals, with a bounded workspace.
findings.verification_plan: Replay mouse scroll and keyboard focus to the price comparison and preview at 80x24; preserve the two-column workspace on taller terminals.
findings.reason: Confirmed task/workflow/standards consequence under the UI severity ladder; repaired and rechecked on current source.

findings.evidence: On a failed initial snapshot the status stays Loading durable trial status; only a price-comparison tooltip mentions the failure.
findings.impact: The owner cannot distinguish loading from failure or discover recovery without hovering a different region.
findings.fix: Show a provider-neutral snapshot failure and Refresh recovery cue above the scrollable body; clear it on a successful read.
findings.verification_plan: Force a synthetic read error, inspect the visible notice and recover after Refresh.
findings.reason: Confirmed task/workflow/standards consequence under the UI severity ladder; repaired and rechecked on current source.

findings.locator: bar_view and paint_snapshot previous/current bar labels
findings.evidence: Saturated rising background #1ee61e with inherited light #e0e0e0 text has less than 3:1 contrast. No inactive/incidental exception applies: these are enabled detail buttons.
findings.impact: A strong rising move makes its numeric bar label unreadable even under the lower large-text contrast threshold.
findings.fix: Choose black or white from background luminance for each bar, and use a darker primary Preview background with opaque white text.
findings.verification_plan: Check all 201 movement intensities against 4.5:1 and render strong rising/falling bars.
findings.reason: Confirmed task/workflow/standards consequence under the UI severity ladder; repaired and rechecked on current source.

findings.evidence: Original source stripped GREEN/YELLOW/RED labels to a colored dot. Default source thresholds were explained only on hover.
findings.impact: Without hue the owner cannot distinguish live, delayed and stale source status directly.
findings.fix: Append LIVE, DELAYED, STALE and STALE PAIR words while retaining the silent dot.
findings.verification_plan: Inspect fresh/stale and single-provider captures for textual state.
findings.reason: Confirmed task/workflow/standards consequence under the UI severity ladder; repaired and rechecked on current source.

findings.evidence: p28-before.txt: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get' when a nested per-asset section is missing/null.
findings.impact: A partial provider snapshot crashes the terminal instead of keeping feed controls available for recovery.
findings.fix: Normalize missing per-asset sections and reuse the normalized MTF data instead of reading the unsafe raw section again.
findings.verification_plan: Same partial-data regression after repair plus missing-data capture at all terminal sizes.
findings.reason: Confirmed task/workflow/standards consequence under the UI severity ladder; repaired and rechecked on current source.

findings.locator: manual-preview-current/small after PR303: leverage-result and workspace
findings.evidence: Actual current-format market preview expands result to12/16rows, collapses the current-height workspace to1row and pushes action/footer or critical text below the viewport. p31-integration-before.txt reproduces both viewport failures.
findings.impact: Reviewing a real preview obscures monitoring and makes its full consequence warning or repeated actions hard to reach.
findings.fix: Bound the result in a keyboard/mouse scroll region and place verified market/indicative-entry/close-unavailable summary first.
findings.verification_plan: Same long-preview regression at80x24 and120x42; new full frozen matrix with the actual Console.preview fixture message.
